blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Feed-forward visual geometry transformers such as VGGT reconstruct dense 3D structure from images in a single forward pass, simplifying multi-view 3D reconstruction.
However, their quadratic attention complexity makes them difficult to scale to long sequences with thousands of frames.
Chunk-and-align frameworks address this by splitting a long sequence into overlapping chunks and stitching their local reconstructions into a pose graph.
Yet existing methods connect only sequentially adjacent chunks, so small per-frame errors accumulate along the chain into large-scale drift.
To move beyond sequential edges, we propose VGGT-Bridge, which adds long-range skip edges that directly constrain non-adjacent chunks without retraining.
By running VGGT on sparsely sampled coarse chunks, each coarse chunk bridges distant fine chunks into a single direct constraint.
We further turn VGGT’s first-frame scale bias into a drift correction by feeding selected coarse chunks in reverse, and a loop-aware policy keeps this reversal compatible with existing loop closures.
VGGT-Bridge reduces ATE by 28.3% on KITTI Odometry, 18.8% on Virtual KITTI, and 10.0% on Waymo Open over the SwiftVGGT baseline, achieving the best performance among all chunk-and-align methods.
blocks.zh:
VGGT等Feed-forward可视几何变速器从图像中从单个前传重建密集的3D结构,简化多视图3D重建.
然而,它们的四相注意力复杂性使得它们难以被分级到有上千帧的长序.
Chunk-and-ign框架解决这个问题,将一长串排列成相重叠的块并把它们的局部重建缝合成平面图.
然而,现有的方法仅相接相接的块相接相接,因此每帧的小出错会沿着链条积聚成大规模的漂移.
为了超越相继的边缘,我们提出VGGT-Bridge,它增加了远程跳过边缘,直接限制非相邻块而无需再培训.
通过运行 VGGT 在稀有样本粗糙块上, 每个粗糙块桥 遥远的细块 形成单一的直接约束。
我们进一步将VGGT的第一帧比例偏差转化为向所选择的粗块倒入的漂移修正,而循环意识政策则保持了与现有循环关闭相容的倒置.
VGGT-Bridge在KITTI Odometry上将ATE减少28.3%,在Virtual KITTI上减少18.8%,在Waymo Open上将SwiftVGGT基线减少10.0%,实现所有块和对齐方法的最佳性能.

blocks.zh: 导言

Figure 1 : Prior methods connect only sequentially adjacent chunks ( 𝐒 1 → 𝐒 2 → ⋯ \mathbf{S}_{1}\!\to\!\mathbf{S}_{2}\!\to\!\cdots ), so per-frame errors accumulate along the chain into large-scale drift.
VGGT-Bridge inserts skip edges (pink arcs, e.g . , 𝐒 1 → 𝐒 3 \mathbf{S}_{1}\!\to\!\mathbf{S}_{3} ) that directly constrain non-adjacent chunks under the chunk-and-align pipeline.
On KITTI Odometry Seq. 08, these long-range constraints lower ATE RMSE to 47.1 47.1 m.

Feed-forward visual geometry transformers such as VGGT [ 43 ] , DUSt3R [ 46 ] , and MASt3R [ 21 ] predict dense per-frame depth, camera pose and 3D structure directly from a sequence of images in a single forward pass.
They have dramatically simplified multi-view 3D reconstruction by eliminating feature matching, bundle adjustment, and iterative refinement.
Many real-world applications, such as autonomous driving and large-scale mapping, require reconstructing long video sequences with thousands of frames, yet these models still struggle to scale because their attention complexity grows quadratically with the number of input frames.
To scale these models to long sequences, a common chunk-and-align pipeline [ 8 , 20 ] splits a long sequence into overlapping chunks, runs the feed-forward model on each chunk independently, and aligns neighboring chunks through the frames shared in their overlaps.
blocks.zh:
VGGT [43], DUST3R [46]等Feed-forward可视几何变速器,以及 MAST3R [21] 预测出每帧高密度的深度,相机姿势和三维结构,直接取自单个前行通道中的一串图像.
它们通过取消特性匹配,捆绑调整和迭代完善,大大简化了多视图3D重建.
许多现实世界的应用,如自主驱动和大规模绘图,需要用上千帧来重建长相视频序列,然而这些模型仍然难以进行规模化,因为它们的注意力复杂性随着输入帧的数量而四倍地增长.
为了将这些模型缩放到长序上,一个常见的块和对称管道[8,20]将长序分割成相重叠的块,在每个块上独立运行向导模型,并通过相邻的块通过相重叠的框来对接相邻的块.

blocks.en:
However, these methods connect only temporally adjacent chunks, so two chunks more than one step apart are related solely through the chain of intermediate alignments.
Small errors in these local alignments propagate along the chain, and even after global pose graph optimization they accumulate into large-scale drift.
Also, VGGT anchors each chunk to its first frame as a reference and reconstructs later frames at a progressively smaller scale.
This anchoring bias worsens the drift, since the shrinkage acts in one direction and its errors accumulate rather than cancel.
When a reliable revisit is detected, loop closure can supply occasional non-local constraints, yet such edges are sparse and may be absent in non-revisiting sequences, such as long, loop-free highway driving.
blocks.zh:
然而,这些方法只连接在时间上相邻的块,因此两个相隔不止一步的块完全通过中间对接的链来相接.
这些局部对接的小错误沿链传播,即使在全球布局优化后,它们也会累积成大规模的漂移.
此外,VGGT将每个站点固定在第一个站台上,作为参考,并在逐渐缩小的尺度上重建后站台.
这种锚定的偏差使漂移更加恶化,因为收缩是朝一个方向行走的,其误差累积而不是取消.
当检测出可靠的再审时,循环闭塞可以提供偶尔的非局部限制,然而这种边缘是稀少的,在非复读序列中可能不存在,例如长而无循环的高速公路行驶.

blocks.en:
Motivated by this, we propose VGGT-Bridge, which adds training-free long-range constraints to the same lightweight pose graph, without retraining the model or using external modules.
VGGT-Bridge consists of three components.
First, we augment the sequential chain with long-range skip edges between non-adjacent chunks.
Running the same model on coarse chunks, which sample frames more sparsely and span a wider temporal range, each coarse chunk bridges and directly constrains the distant fine chunks it overlaps.
Second, to correct the anchoring bias, we reverse the input frame order of selected coarse chunks, which shifts their scale against the bias and turns the skip edge into a corrective anti-bias signal for the constructed pose graph.
Finally, this reversal can conflict with the loop closures that already correct scale drift in loop-rich regions.
We therefore introduce a policy that reverses only where drift dominates and stays forward where reliable loops are present.
blocks.zh:
以此为动机,我们提出VGGT-Bridge,在同样的轻量级外形图上添加了无训练的长程限制,而不对模型进行再培训或使用外部模块.
VGGT-Bridge由三个组件组成.
首先,我们用非相邻块之间的长距离跳跃边缘来增强相继链.
在粗块上运行同样的模型,样本框架比较稀少,跨出更宽的时间范围,每个粗块桥直接限制相距遥远的细块重叠.
第二,为了纠正锚定偏差,我们反转了所选粗块的输入帧顺序,这个顺序将它们的尺度与偏差相向,并将跳跃边缘变成构造的姿势图的正反偏差信号.
最后,这种倒转可能与循环丰富的地区已经纠正了规模漂移的循环关闭相冲突.
因此,我们采取的政策只有在漂移占主导地位的地方才能扭转,在存在可靠循环的地方才能向前走。

blocks.en:
We extensively validate VGGT-Bridge on three driving benchmarks, KITTI Odometry [ 13 ] , Waymo Open Dataset [ 37 ] , and Virtual KITTI [ 12 ] , where it attains the best performance among all chunk-and-align methods.
On KITTI Odometry, VGGT-Bridge lowers the Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE) from 31.53 31.53 m to 22.61 22.61 m over the SwiftVGGT baseline, with the largest gains on drift-dominated sequences.
Beyond the overall accuracy, we directly verify the underlying mechanism, showing that reverse anchoring shifts the scale of skip edges in the direction opposite to the bias and that this anti-bias signal suppresses global scale drift.
Furthermore, we provide component ablations and an efficiency analysis that support the contribution of each design choice.
In summary, our key contributions are as follows: ∙ \bullet We propose VGGT-Bridge, which links non-adjacent chunks with skip edges to add long-range constraints to the chunk-and-align pipeline, without any training or external module. ∙ \bullet We correct the first-frame anchoring bias of feed-forward models by reversing the input order of selected coarse chunks, with a loop-aware policy setting each chunk’s direction to stay compatible with real loop closures. ∙ \bullet Through extensive experiments on KITTI Odometry, Waymo Open Dataset, and Virtual KITTI, we show that VGGT-Bridge achieves the best performance among all chunk-and-align methods, and validate its design through analyses of the scale bias and component ablations.
blocks.zh:
我们广泛地验证了VGGT-Bridge在KITTI Odometry [13],Waymo Open Datas集 [37],以及Virtual KITTI [12] 三个驱动基准,在其中,它在所有分块和对齐方法中都取得了最佳的性能.
在KITTI Odometry上,VGGT-Bridge将绝对轨迹出错(ATE)从31.53 31.53米降至22.61 22.61米比斯威夫特VGGT基线低,在以漂流为主的序列上收益最大.
除了总体准确性之外,我们直接验证基本机制,显示反向锚定会使跳跃边缘的尺度向相反偏差的方向移动,而这种反斜向信号会抑制全球尺度漂移.
此外,我们还提供部分内容和效率分析,以支持每项设计选择的贡献。
总之,我们的主要贡献如下: 我们提出VGGT-Bridge,它将非相邻块与跳过边缘相接,为块与对接管道增加长距离限制,而无需进行任何训练或外部模块. * 弹出 我们通过改变选定粗块的输入顺序来纠正向导模型的第一帧锚定偏差,同时制定环感政策,确定每个块的方向,使其与真正的环相容。 通过对KITTI Odometry、Waymo Open Datas集和Virtual KITTI的广泛实验,我们显示VGGT-Bridge在所有块和相接方法中取得了最佳的性能,并通过对尺度偏差和组件的活化分析来验证其设计。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Feed-forward visual geometry models. Classical 3D reconstruction relies on modular pipelines for correspondence estimation, camera recovery, triangulation, and bundle adjustment [ 15 , 1 , 33 , 32 , 23 , 31 ] .
Learning-based SfM methods improve or differentiate parts of this pipeline [ 38 , 48 , 39 , 36 , 44 ] , but still retain explicit geometric estimation and optimization.
Feed-forward visual geometry models take a more direct route, predicting dense 3D structure from images with pretrained networks.
Beginning with pairwise point map prediction [ 46 , 21 ] , recent systems extend this paradigm with spatial memory, unconstrained SfM, or multi-view reconstruction [ 42 , 9 , 52 , 47 , 43 ] .
While these models provide strong short-window geometry, their global attention scales quadratically with the number of frames, making long sequences prohibitively expensive.
blocks.zh:
Feed-forward视觉几何模型. 经典的3D重建依赖于模块化管道进行函证估算,相机恢复,三角化,并进行捆绑调整[15, 1, 33, 32, 23, 31].
基于学习的SfM方法改进或区分了这一管道的部分[38,48,39,36,44],但仍保留了明确的几何估计和优化.
Feed-forward可视几何模型采取更直接的路线,从带有被预先训练网络的图像中预测密集的3D结构.
从对等点地图预测[46, 21]开始,最近的系统以空间内存,不受约束的SfM,或多视图重建[42, 9, 52, 47, 43]来扩展这个范式.
虽然这些模型提供了很强的短窗口几何学,但其全球关注范围却以帧数为四分之多,使得长序列令人望而却步地昂贵.

blocks.en:
Classical long-scene reconstruction. Long-scene reconstruction has traditionally been addressed by simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) and incremental structure-from-motion (SfM), where a visual front-end establishes short-range geometric constraints from image measurements and a geometric back-end refines camera poses and map structure over time [ 17 , 11 , 27 , 28 , 3 , 10 , 34 , 39 , 40 ] .
These systems combine local tracking or odometry with map-level optimization, and reduce long-term drift by adding non-local constraints from loop detection and visual place recognition [ 30 , 16 ] .
The resulting loop edges are incorporated through pose graph or factor graph optimization backends [ 14 , 18 , 7 ] .
This pipeline has been highly effective for long sequences, but it relies on a carefully designed stack of correspondence estimation, mapping, place recognition, and optimization.
Recent feed-forward approaches pursue the same goal of long-scene consistency while replacing much of this hand-designed front-end with learned dense geometry priors.
blocks.zh:
古典长相重建. 长幕重建传统上通过同步局部化和绘图(SLAM)和增量结构自动(SfM)来解决,视觉前端通过图像测量确定短程几何限制,并用几何后端精细相机摆放和地图结构随时间推移[17,11,27,28,3,10,34,39,40].
这些系统结合了局部跟踪或地平面与地图级优化,并增加了从回路检测和视觉位置识别产生的非局部限制来减少长期漂移[30,16].
由此产生的回路边缘通过平面图或因子图优化后端[14,18,7]被整合.
这种管道对长序非常有效,但它依赖于精心设计的堆积函证估计,绘图,位置识别,以及优化.
最近的向导方法追求的是长相场景一致性的同一项目标,同时用所学到的密集几何学前身来取而代之的是这个手工设计的前端的大部分.

blocks.en:
Extending feed-forward models to long scenes. One line of work modifies the model or inference process itself, using spatial memory, recurrent states, streaming formulations, or test-time training to extend the temporal context available to the network [ 49 , 5 , 45 , 4 , 19 , 55 , 6 , 54 , 50 ] .
These approaches broaden the usable context, but often require retraining, architectural changes, or a streaming reformulation.
A complementary direction keeps the pretrained model fixed and moves long-scene consistency outside the network by constructing a graph over local reconstructions [ 29 , 25 , 24 , 53 ] .
Chunk-and-align pipelines follow this route.
They split a long sequence into overlapping chunks, run the feed-forward model on each, and fuse the local reconstructions in a global pose graph.
VGGT-Long [ 8 ] aligns neighboring chunks with Iteratively Reweighted Least Squares (IRLS) over Sim(3) and adds loop closures from visual place recognition, while SwiftVGGT [ 20 ] replaces the iterative alignment with a single-shot Umeyama SVD [ 41 ] step and reuses the model’s internal descriptors for loop detection.
VGGT-Motion [ 51 ] uses motion-aware submaps to reduce redundant VGGT processing and improve submap alignment.
Despite these differences, existing graph-based approaches remain largely sequential, with most constraints coming from adjacent chunk overlaps and non-local edges mainly arising from loop closures.
Our work instead introduces additional long-range constraints that connect distant chunks beyond the sequential overlap chain.
blocks.zh:
将feed-forward模型扩展到长场景. 一行工作修改了模型或推论过程本身,使用空间内存,经常性状态,流出配体,或试验时间训练来扩展网络可用的时间背景[49,5,45,4,19,55,6,54,50].
这些方法拓宽了可用的背景,但往往需要再培训、建筑改变或流线再造。
辅助方向通过绘制一个图来固定预先训练过的模型,并将长场一致性移出网络之外[29、25、24、53]。
春克通航管线沿此通航.
他们将一个长的序列分割成相重叠的块,在每一个块上运行向导的模型,并用一个全局的图来将当地的重建融合起来.
VGGT-Long [8] 将相邻块与相邻的Literative再加权最小方块(IRLS)相比于Sim(3),并增加了视觉位置识别的回路关闭,而SwiftVGGT [20] 则用一发Umeyama SVD [41] 台阶来取代迭接对接并再用模型的内部描述符进行回路检测.
VGGT-Motion [51] 使用运动感知子图来减少冗余的VGGT处理并改进子图对接.
尽管存在这些差异,但现有的以图表为基础的方法在很大程度上仍然是相继的,大多数制约因素来自相邻块相重叠和非局部边缘,主要出自循环关闭.
相反,我们的工作引入了额外的长期限制,将相继重叠链以外的遥远块连接起来。

blocks.en:
We first review the chunk-and-align pipeline that our method builds on, which reconstructs a long sequence by splitting it into chunks and stitching their local reconstructions into a single pose graph.
We then give an overview of VGGT-Bridge, which augments this pose graph with training-free long-range edges to reduce the drift that accumulates along the sequence.

blocks.en: Chunk-and-Align Pipeline
blocks.zh: 春克和对齐管道

blocks.en:
Given an image sequence { I 1 , … , I N } \{I_{1},\dots,I_{N}\} , a chunk-and-align pipeline splits it into overlapping fine chunks F 1 , … , F M F_{1},\dots,F_{M} , each spanning B B contiguous frames with O O overlapping frames.
It runs VGGT [ 43 ] on each chunk independently and obtains per-frame extrinsics, depth, and 3D points expressed in the chunk’s local coordinate system.
For each chunk, the first input image is assigned identity extrinsics and serves as the reference frame.
A pairwise Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) alignment is then computed between each pair of consecutive chunks F i , F i + 1 F_{i},F_{i+1} from their O O overlapping frames, yielding the relative transformation 𝐒 i , i + 1 ∈ Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathbf{S}_{i,i+1}\in\mathrm{Sim}(3) , parametrized by a scale s ∈ ℝ > 0 s\in\mathbb{R}_{>0} , a rotation 𝐑 ∈ SO ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathbf{R}\in\mathrm{SO}(3) , and a translation 𝐭 ∈ ℝ 3 \mathbf{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{3} .
To correct the drift these sequential alignments accumulate, it further links revisited chunks F i , F j F_{i},F_{j} with loop-closure alignments 𝐒 i ​ j loop \mathbf{S}_{ij}^{\mathrm{loop}} , where revisits are found by place recognition and aligned through a shared loop-centric chunk.
Finally, pose graph optimization recovers the chunk poses in a common frame, treating each pose as a node and each measured transform as an edge that constrains the two poses it connects.
It minimizes the mismatch between every measurement and the relative pose it implies, { 𝐒 i ⋆ } = arg ⁡ min ⁡ ∑ i { 𝐒 i } ⁡ ‖ log ⁡ ( 𝐒 i , i + 1 − 1 ​ 𝐒 i − 1 ​ 𝐒 i + 1 ) ‖ 2 + ∑ ( i , j ) ‖ log ⁡ ( ( 𝐒 i ​ j loop ) − 1 ​ 𝐒 i − 1 ​ 𝐒 j ) ‖ 2 , \{\mathbf{S}_{i}^{\star}\}\;=\;\arg\min_{\{\mathbf{S}_{i}\}}\;\sum_{i}\bigl\|\log\!\bigl(\mathbf{S}_{i,i+1}^{-1}\mathbf{S}_{i}^{-1}\mathbf{S}_{i+1}\bigr)\bigr\|^{2}\;+\!\!\sum_{(i,j)}\bigl\|\log\!\bigl((\mathbf{S}_{ij}^{\mathrm{loop}})^{-1}\mathbf{S}_{i}^{-1}\mathbf{S}_{j}\bigr)\bigr\|^{2}, (1) solved with Levenberg–Marquardt [ 22 , 26 ] on the Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) manifold.

blocks.en: VGGT-Bridge
blocks.zh: VGGT- 桥

blocks.en:
We augment the pose graph with long-range edges through three components, leaving both the feed-forward model and the optimizer unchanged, as illustrated in Fig. 2 .
First, we run VGGT on coarse-stride chunks that each overlap several fine chunks, and compose their alignments into a skip edge directly constraining two non-adjacent fine chunks, as detailed in Sec. 3.2 .
Second, we identify a first-frame anchor bias in VGGT and feed selected coarse chunks in reverse temporal order, turning the skip edge into a pseudo loop closure whose reverse-coarse constraint counteracts the accumulated scale drift, developed in Sec. 3.3 .
Third, a loop-aware policy selects the coarse anchor position per chunk, reconciling the skip edges with loop closures in loop-rich regions, which we describe in Sec. 3.4 .
All edges, sequential, loop, and skip, are then optimized jointly in a single Sim(3) pose graph, as formalized in Sec. 3.5 .

blocks.en: 3.3 Reverse-anchored coarse chunks
blocks.zh: 3.3 倒置粗糙块

blocks.en:
VGGT anchors each chunk at its first input frame, and this anchoring biases the reconstructed scale to shrink away from that anchor as the input advances.
Since every chunk is anchored the same way, this bias always acts in the same direction, so the scale drift accumulates without canceling along the sequential edges.
A loop closure would correct this drift by supplying the pose graph with a constraint from a revisited place, but such a constraint is available only where a revisit is detected, leaving the drift uncorrected in loop-free regions.
In these regions, we repurpose the skip edge as a pseudo loop closure, a non-local constraint that corrects drift in place of a real loop closure.
blocks.zh:
VGGT在第一个输入框上锁定每个块,这种锁定偏差使重建的尺度随着输入的推进而从主锚上收缩.
由于每个块都以同样的方式锚定,这种偏差总是在同一个方向上行走,因此相平平面漂移会累积而不会沿着相接的边缘被取消.
循环关闭可以纠正这种漂移现象,办法是向姿势图提供来自重新审视地点的制约,但只有在发现重新审视时才存在这种制约,使无循环区域的漂移现象得不到纠正。
在这些地区,我们重新将跳跃边缘作为伪环闭合,一种非局部的制约来纠正漂移来代替真正的环闭.

blocks.en:
A default skip edge is built from coarse chunks that are anchored at their first frame, just like the fine chunks, so it carries the same first-frame bias and cannot counteract the drift it shares with the sequential edges.
We reverse this bias by feeding the frames of the coarse chunk that forms the skip edge in reverse temporal order.
The forward-anchored chunk C k r , fwd C_{k}^{r,\mathrm{fwd}} , used everywhere so far, feeds its frames ( f 1 , … , f B r ) (f_{1},\dots,f_{B^{r}}) in temporal order and is anchored at the earliest frame f 1 f_{1} .
The reverse-anchored chunk C k r , rev C_{k}^{r,\mathrm{rev}} feeds the same frames in reverse order ( f B r , … , f 1 ) (f_{B^{r}},\dots,f_{1}) , moving the anchor to the latest frame f B r f_{B^{r}} , and its outputs are then reordered to temporal order for alignment.

We call the skip edge composed from a forward-anchored chunk a forward skip edge, and the one composed from a reverse-anchored chunk a reverse skip edge.
Reversing the input leaves the composition of Eq. 3 unchanged but moves the anchor from the first frame to the last, so the scale bias now acts in the opposite direction.
The reverse skip edge therefore introduces a scale constraint in the direction opposite to the accumulated forward drift, acting as an anti-bias constraint.

倒置输入让Eq. 3的构成不变,但将锚从第一个帧移到最后一个帧上,因此比例偏差现在起到相反的作用.
因此,反向跳跃边缘对方向引入了与累积前向漂移相反的尺度限制,起到反斜向制约的作用.

blocks.en:
Fig. 3 presents qualitative camera trajectory comparisons on representative sequences (Seq. 01, Seq. 02, Seq. 09) of the KITTI Odometry dataset.
Following SwiftVGGT [ 20 ] , we build the pseudo ground-truth point cloud by accumulating LiDAR scans with the ground-truth poses.
Our method consistently achieves lower ATE than the baselines, and this improvement is also clearly visible in the trajectories.
The three sequences represent distinct loop conditions.
Seq. 01 is a loop-free highway sequence.
SwiftVGGT progressively underestimates the scale toward the end and its dense reconstruction collapses, whereas our method recovers the open-ended trajectory that matches the ground-truth.
On Seq. 02, where loop detection fails to close the loop precisely, our method still produces a trajectory better aligned with the ground-truth and lowers the ATE.
On Seq. 09, where the loop is correctly closed, the adaptive policy adds skip edges without conflicting with the loop closures and further improves the trajectory.
Overall, these qualitative results confirm that the skip edge and pseudo-loop closures induced by coarse chunks mitigate scale drift and yield globally consistent trajectories across different loop conditions, corroborating our quantitative results.
We further report the standard 3D reconstruction metrics of Accuracy, Completeness, and Chamfer Distance in Supp.

The bias exists and shifts with anchoring. We record the pairwise Umeyama scale s s of every alignment that forms an edge in the pose graph on KITTI Odometry 00–10, and report its mean and standard deviation over the eleven sequences.
Fine-sequential alignments are always forward-anchored, whereas each coarse chunk is measured both forward-anchored and reverse-anchored.
In the ideal case, aligning two chunks that reconstruct the same overlap region would give no scale difference, so log ⁡ s = 0 \log s=0 .
The mean log scale across the fine-sequential edges is − 0.037 -0.037 , meaning a forward-ordered chunk is reconstructed at roughly 3.6 % 3.6\% smaller scale than its predecessor, a one-sided shrinking bias.
Composed forward skip edges inherit this bias.
To isolate the effect of reversal, we compare forward- and reverse-anchored estimates for the same skip edges at each stride, and measure the per-edge shift as Δ = log ⁡ s rev − log ⁡ s fwd \Delta{=}\log s_{\mathrm{rev}}{-}\log s_{\mathrm{fwd}} .
Reverse anchoring moves the mean log scale from − 0.032 -0.032 to + 0.036 +0.036 at stride 3 and from − 0.026 -0.026 to + 0.043 +0.043 at stride 5. Δ \Delta averages 0.068 ± 0.037 0.068\pm 0.037 at stride 3 and 0.069 ± 0.029 0.069\pm 0.029 at stride 5, and is positive for 85 % 85\% and 83 % 83\% of the edges, respectively.
The reverse skip edge therefore shifts the scale estimate in the direction opposite to the forward bias, supplying the anti-bias signal that the forward chain lacks.

blocks.en:
To assess the efficiency of our method, we measure the total processing time and FPS on the KITTI Odometry benchmark using a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU.
As shown in Table 6 , compared to VGGT-Long, which relies on costly IRLS optimization, our method is 2.0 × 2.0\times faster while achieving 9.0 % 9.0\% lower ATE RMSE.

This indicates that augmenting the sequential edges between adjacent chunks with additional skip edges yields a substantial performance improvement.
Overall, our method achieves a better speed–accuracy trade-off than VGGT-Long, while improving the performance of SwiftVGGT at a reasonable additional cost.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We present VGGT-Bridge, a training-free method that adds long-range skip edges to the chunk-and-align 3D reconstruction pipeline.
By running VGGT at coarse strides, each coarse chunk bridges non-adjacent fine chunks into a direct constraint.
Reverse anchoring then turns VGGT’s first-frame scale bias into a drift correction, while a loop-aware policy keeps this reversal compatible with real loop closures.
Across KITTI Odometry, Waymo Open Dataset, and Virtual KITTI, VGGT-Bridge attains the best mean ATE RMSE among all chunk-and-align methods, reducing the error by 28.3%, 10.0%, and 18.8% over the SwiftVGGT baseline.
Our mechanism analysis confirms that reverse anchoring counteracts the scale bias of skip edges and suppresses the accumulated scale drift, and our ablations show that each component contributes to the final performance.
These results show that adding long-range skip edges is a practical and effective way to reduce accumulated drift in chunk-and-align reconstruction.

blocks.en: Appendix 0.C Cross-framework transfer: VGGT-Long
blocks.zh: 附录0.C 跨框架转让:VGGT-Long

blocks.en:
To test whether our contribution is tied to a particular alignment style or is a general pose-graph augmentation, we transplant the full VGGT-Bridge recipe onto VGGT-Long [ 8 ] .
The two backbones differ only in how each chunk alignment Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) is estimated, while sharing the same Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) pose graph and the same Levenberg–Marquardt [ 22 , 26 ] solver.
SwiftVGGT estimates it with a single Umeyama step on the filtered 3D points, as in our default setting.
VGGT-Long instead runs Iteratively Reweighted Least Squares (IRLS), repeating a weighted Umeyama step while recomputing the Huber term of each weight from its current residual.
Each weight combines the VGGT confidence with a Huber term that downweights high-residual points, so unreliable ones contribute less as the iterations proceed.
The two estimators differ sharply in this respect, so transferring the same method across them tests whether the skip edge is specific to the single-step Umeyama estimator or generalizes to an iteratively reweighted one.
blocks.zh:
为了测试我们的贡献是否与特定的对齐样式挂钩,还是一般的平面图增强,我们将完整的VGGT-Bridge配方移植到VGGT-Long [8].
两种主干仅在每个块对齐Sim → (3)\mathrm{Sim}(3)如何估计而不同,同时共享相同的Sim → (3)\mathrm{Sim}(3)的图和相同的Levenberg–Marquardt [22,26] 解析器.
SwiftVGGT在被过滤的3D分上用一个Umeyama步骤来估计,就像我们的默认设置一样.
VGGT - Long 代替运行 惯性地重取最小方块(IRLS),重复一个加权的Umeyama步骤,同时从目前的剩余量中重新计算出每个重量的Huber名词.
每个重量结合了VGGT信心和一个Huber名词,即降低分量高的剩余分数,因此不可靠的分数随着重迭的进行而贡献更小.
两种估计法在这方面差异很大,因此将相同的方法在它们之间转移,测试跳跃边缘是单步Umeyama估计法所特有的,还是概括为迭代再加权法.

blocks.en:
The three method components transfer as is, namely the coarse-stride skip edge, the reverse-anchored coarse chunk, and the loop-aware adaptive direction policy.
The only change is inside skip-edge composition, where each fine–coarse Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) is now solved by the confidence-weighted IRLS estimator rather than a single Umeyama step, matching the host backbone.
In Eq. 7 , the edge type with the larger alignment residual can dominate the optimization, so we set the skip-edge scalars from the ratio of skip-edge to sequential-edge residuals.
On SwiftVGGT, the median Umeyama residual of a skip edge is 0.106 0.106 against 0.052 0.052 for a sequential edge, a ratio of 2.0 × 2.0\times .
IRLS on VGGT-Long tightens the sequential edges to 0.024 0.024 while the skip edges stay at 0.123 0.123 , raising the ratio to 5.1 × 5.1\times .
We therefore recalibrate three scalars so the looser skip constraint is weighted appropriately against the tighter sequential and loop edges.
We tighten the Huber threshold to δ = 0.05 \delta{=}0.05 , so the IRLS reweighting discounts high-residual correspondences more aggressively.
We lower the skip-edge base weight to w ¯ = 0.1 \bar{w}{=}0.1 , so that the looser skip edges do not dominate the tighter sequential edges.
We set the loop-aware adaptive direction threshold to τ = 0.05 \tau{=}0.05 , so reverse anchoring is applied only where loops are essentially absent.
blocks.zh:
目前的三种方法组件,即:粗通跳出边缘、倒置粗通块和有环感的适应方向政策。
唯一的变化在于跳跃构成内部,其中每个精细-粗糙的Sim (3)\mathrm{Sim}(3)现在都由置信加权的IRLS估计器解决,而不是单一的Umeyama步骤,匹配主机骨干.
在 Eq. 7 中,有较大对齐后残留的边缘类型可以主导优化,因此我们设定了从跳跃后残留到相继后残留的比分的跳跃后平板.
在斯威夫特VGGT上,一个跳跃边缘的中位数Umeyama残基为0.106 0.106对相继边缘0.052 0.052,比例为2.0×2.0\时.
VGGT-Long上的IRLS将相继边缘收紧到0.024 0.024,而跳跃边缘则停留在0.123 0.123 上,将比值提高到5.1× 5.1\时.

For each sequence, we merge the reconstructed point maps of each frame into a single global point cloud.
The point clouds of all methods are randomly downsampled to a common density, coarsely aligned to the ground truth with a Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) Umeyama step, and refined with Iterative Closest Point (ICP).
Under the same pre-processing protocol, we report three metrics.
Accuracy (Acc) is the RMSE of nearest-neighbor distances from the prediction to the ground truth, Completeness (Comp) is the RMSE in the reverse direction, and the Chamfer Distance (CD) is the mean of the two.

To isolate where the 1.5 × 1.5\times slowdown in Table 6 of the main paper comes from, we measure per-stage wall-clock time on a short and a long sequence, KITTI Odometry Seq. 07 (1,101 frames) and Seq. 08 (4,071 frames).
While Table 6 times the full pipeline, here we report only the major computation stages, so that the effect of adding VGGT-Bridge is visible per stage. Table 13 reports the breakdown together with the coarse chunk and skip edge counts that drive each stage.
The added cost is concentrated in the coarse VGGT [ 43 ] inference and the skip-edge composition.
These two stages account for nearly all of the overhead, adding + 26.3 +26.3 s and + 28.5 +28.5 s on Seq. 07 and + 110.3 +110.3 s and + 38.7 +38.7 s on Seq. 08.
Each coarse chunk spans far fewer frames than a fine chunk, with B 3 = 35 B^{3}{=}35 and B 5 = 25 B^{5}{=}25 against the 75 75 frames of a fine chunk.
The extra VGGT inference therefore stays a moderate trade-off, despite the larger number of coarse chunks.
The pose graph optimization absorbs the additional skip edges with little overhead, since skip edges add only constraints and the number of pose variables to solve stays the same.
Even on Seq. 08 with 98 98 skip edges, its solve time rises only from 0.1 0.1 s to 1.0 1.0 s.
The remaining stages take almost the same time in both methods.

blocks.en: Appendix 0.J Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录0.J 限制

blocks.en:
Our framework inherits limitations from both the VGGT backbone and the loop-closure detector. Because it operates at the graph level, it does not directly denoise the VGGT predictions themselves. Severe backbone errors can therefore still be propagated through the cross-scale skip edges. The adaptive anchoring policy is also limited by the reliability of loop detection, and missed loop closures in visually ambiguous or textureless scenes can lead to suboptimal anchor selection.
VGGT-Bridge requires additional VGGT runs on coarse-stride chunks, increasing inference time.
Like other VGGT-based reconstruction methods, it assumes a predominantly static scene, and handling dynamic objects is orthogonal to our contribution.
blocks.zh:
我们的框架继承了VGGT主干线和环闭探测器的局限性. 由于它运行在图级,所以它不会直接使VGGT预测本身暴露出. 因此,严重的骨干出错仍然可以通过跨尺度跳出边缘传播。 适应性锚定政策也受到了循环探测可靠性的限制,在视觉上模棱两可或无纹理的场景中错失了循环闭塞,可能导致低于最佳的锚定选择.
VGGT-Bridge需要额外的VGGT运行于粗糙的出行地块上,增加推论时间.
与其他基于VGGT的重建方法一样,它假设一个以静态为主的场景,处理活性物体对我们的贡献是正交的.

We provide qualitative dense reconstruction results on the KITTI Odometry [ 13 ] , Waymo Open [ 37 ] , and Virtual KITTI [ 12 ] datasets in Figs. 5 , 6 and 7 .
For KITTI Odometry we compare the aggregated point clouds of VGGT-Bridge against VGGT-Long and SwiftVGGT in RGB color, while for Waymo Open and Virtual KITTI we show the VGGT-Bridge reconstructions in both RGB color and a height-based color map.
These results show that VGGT-Bridge produces high-quality dense 3D reconstructions across diverse large-scale driving scenarios, consistent with its tracking accuracy.

我们为KITTI Odometry[13]、Waymo Open[37]和虚拟KITTI[12]数据集提供质量密集的重建结果。
为KITTI 我们用 RGB 颜色比较 VGGT-Bridge 和 VGGT-Long 和 SwiftVGGT 的集合点云, 而对于 Waymo Open 和 Virtual KITTI , 我们用 RGB 颜色和一个高基色图来显示 VGGT-Bridge 重建 。
这些结果显示,VGGT-Bridge在各种大型驾驶场景中产生高质量的密集的3D重建,这符合其跟踪的准确性.
